_about: Admiral lines (R37 step 1; rewritten to lore round 8, R59). Each admiral speaks in their faction's voice at fixed moments. Moments: pick (the admiral card), sector (a new sector's intro box), start (battle start, one line picked by the battle seed), boss (a battle against a sector flagship), nemesis (a battle against the Nemesis's fleet), kill_flag (an enemy flagship destroyed), lost (your first ship lost in a battle), flag_hurt (your flagship below 40% hull), command (your Command fires), win, loss. Placeholders: {flagship} your flagship's name, {rival} the Nemesis's full name, {enemy} the enemy faction's name. The Nemesis's own lines live in rival_lines.json (pools by his faction and personality). Voices (lore_bible_r8.md 1.3): Sunward Crusade oaths, chalk names, dawn, cold and debts; Hegemony data, projections and the Registry; Hullbreakers short and brutal, trails, sound and the pack; the Chorus says we, taste, heat and teeth, and never sings; Glasswrights light, glass and grief, quiet and precise; Eclipse memory, the dark and the lost sun, counted years and worn bodies. No em dashes anywhere (checked by test/story_test.gd).

vex.pick: Form the line. The line is the oath, kept in iron.
vex.sector: Another sector, colder than the last. We cross it the old way: broadside by broadside.
start: Run out the guns. Present the flank.
Hold the line. Let them come to the broadsides.
vex.boss: Their flagship is a fortress. So is ours. We will see whose walls are thicker.
vex.nemesis: {rival}. I chalked your name on the hull the day we launched. Today I rub it out.
vex.kill_flag: Their flagship is ash. Mark the hour on the hull.
vex.lost: A ship of the line is gone. Chalk her name. Close the gap. The line does not break.
vex.flag_hurt: The {flagship} bleeds, but she still has guns. Keep her in the line.
vex.command: Fire for effect. Every gun, every deck, now.
vex.win: The line held. It always holds.
vex.loss: The line is broken. Add my name to the wall, under the others.

malek.pick: Oath-breakers hide. I find them. Then I put a torpedo through them.
malek.sector: New hunting grounds. Every trader here is lying to me, and I will learn why.
start: Torpedoes warm. Find me a soft stern.
They think they are the hunters. Correct them.
malek.boss: A big ship is only a big target. Get behind it.
malek.nemesis: {rival}. I have read every report on you twice. Today I close the account.
malek.kill_flag: Debt collected. Their flagship is finished.
malek.lost: We lost a hunter. I will remember who did it.
malek.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is wounded. Wounded hunters are the dangerous ones.
malek.command: Hunter's salvo. Reload everything and put it in their backs.
malek.win: The hunt is over. Burn the rest.
malek.loss: They were better hidden than I believed. I will not make that error twice.

ashgrove.pick: My pilots fly. The rest of you keep the decks warm.
ashgrove.sector: Fresh sky. Wing leaders, check your fuel and your names on the board, in that order.
start: Launch the wings. Bring me their position in two minutes.
Fighters out, bombers armed. Make the dark crowded.
ashgrove.boss: Big flagship, slow turret tracking. My bombers love that kind.
ashgrove.nemesis: {rival} is out there. Every pilot in this fleet knows the name.
ashgrove.kill_flag: Bombers report the flagship down. Drinks are on the deck crew.
ashgrove.lost: We lost a hull. Recover the pilots if you can. Chalk them if you cannot.
ashgrove.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is taking hits. Screen her. Every wing, now.
ashgrove.command: Scramble everything. If it has wings, it flies.
ashgrove.win: All wings, come home. Good hunting.
ashgrove.loss: Empty decks. I sent them out and they did not come back.

thale.pick: I have outlived three crusades by refusing to die. It is a habit.
thale.sector: Deeper, then. The iron does not mind the cold.
start: Shields to full. Let them break their teeth on us.
Iron doctrine. We stand. They fall.
thale.boss: A worthy wall. We will lean on it until it falls over.
thale.nemesis: {rival}. Let them hit us. Let them see how little it does.
thale.kill_flag: Their flagship is down. The iron endures.
thale.lost: A hull is lost. The rest of us stand closer.
thale.flag_hurt: The {flagship} has taken worse. So have I.
thale.command: Iron wall. Every shield to full. Brace.
thale.win: We are still here. That is the whole of the doctrine.
thale.loss: The iron gave out at last. Remember that it held this long.

kassar.pick: Discipline is a weapon with infinite ammunition.
kassar.sector: New sector. Same standard. The Registry projects a favourable outcome. Synchronise on the flagship.
start: All batteries, synchronise. Fire on my mark.
Column formation. Keep the interval. Keep the discipline.
kassar.boss: Their flagship is the anchor of their fleet. Remove it.
kassar.nemesis: {rival} is on the scanners. Log it. Then destroy it.
kassar.kill_flag: Enemy flagship eliminated. Note the efficiency.
kassar.lost: We have a casualty. Close the interval. Continue.
kassar.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is damaged. The column holds formation regardless.
kassar.command: Synchronised broadside. Every gun, one moment.
kassar.win: Engagement concluded. Losses within acceptable limits.
kassar.loss: Unacceptable. Someone will write a report about this. It will be me.

vorn.pick: I do not miss. I calculate.
vorn.sector: Interdiction grid deployed. Nothing jumps through this sector without a Registry entry.
start: Lock the targets. Wait for the solution.
Interdiction fields up. Let them try to run.
vorn.boss: Every flagship has a weak point. I have already found this one.
vorn.nemesis: {rival}. Their patterns are predictable. Predict them.
vorn.kill_flag: Flagship destroyed. The solution was correct.
vorn.lost: A ship lost. Recalculate the engagement.
vorn.flag_hurt: The {flagship} has damage. The guns are still aligned.
vorn.command: Interdiction strike. Every ship, every shot, now.
vorn.loss: An error in the calculation. I will find it.

reyes.pick: The strike group goes where I point. I point at the enemy.
reyes.sector: New sector. Strike group, prepare for a long sortie.
start: Strike group, launch. Clear the lanes.
Wings up. Let them see the Navy coming.
reyes.boss: That flagship is the prize. Strike group, mark it.
reyes.nemesis: {rival} again. My pilots have been waiting for a rematch.
reyes.kill_flag: Flagship down. Strike group, well flown.
reyes.lost: We lost a ship. The strike group flies on.
reyes.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is hit. Fighters, form a screen on the flag.
reyes.command: Launch the full strike group. Everything that flies.
reyes.loss: The strike group is spent. The Registry will log every name. I will remember them.

maren.pick: The column moves slowly. It does not stop.
maren.sector: Advance. The armour will carry us through.
start: Armour forward. Shields up. Advance.
Close ranks. Let the plating do its work.
maren.boss: A heavy ship. So are we. Forward.
maren.nemesis: {rival} wants to test our armour. Let them.
maren.kill_flag: Their flagship falls. The column advances.
maren.lost: One hull lost. The column closes ranks.
maren.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is holed. The column does not slow.
maren.command: Shield wall order. Every emitter to full.
maren.win: The column stands on the field. The field is ours.
maren.loss: The column has stopped. For the first time.

grax.pick: Ram it. Board it. Strip it. Strongest keeps it.
grax.sector: New hunting ground. I hear engines already. Full burn.
start: Full burn. First to ram takes first pick of the wreck.
Claws out. Go for the loud ones.
grax.boss: Big ship. Big wreck. More to strip.
grax.nemesis: {rival}. I smelled you two jumps out. I owe you a ram.
grax.kill_flag: Their big one is dead. Strip it before it cools.
grax.lost: We lost one. Weak. The rest of you, closer.
grax.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is holed. Good. Now she smells of blood.
grax.command: Full burn. Everyone. Hit them all at once.
grax.win: Strip everything. Bolt the best of it on.
grax.loss: Not strong enough. Next time, bigger claws.

sable.pick: They never hear me. Then they never hear anything.
sable.sector: A new sector, full of soft sterns and loud engines. Good.
start: Run silent. Get behind them. Then bite.
Knives out. Go for the backs.
sable.boss: A great proud flagship. They never watch their backs.
sable.nemesis: {rival}. I have been on your trail for three jumps. You smell tired.
sable.kill_flag: Their flagship, gutted from behind. Clean work.
sable.lost: We lost one. Mark who did it. We will find their wake.
sable.command: Knife in the dark. Reload, and aim low.
sable.loss: Someone heard me first. That does not happen twice.

mott.pick: Forty captains tried to take my ship. My ship is still mine.
mott.sector: New sector. These lanes stink of old fights. Good hunting in them.
start: Let the swarm loose. Mind the rusty ones, they bite.
Hulks, open your bays. Out you go, scrap.
mott.boss: Big flagship. Seen bigger. Seen them burn, too.
mott.nemesis: {rival}. I killed the last one who wanted my ship. You are louder than they were.
mott.kill_flag: Down it goes. First pick of the wreck is mine.
mott.lost: Lost a ship. Its captain was weak. Pick a new one.
mott.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is held together with wire and spite. It will hold.
mott.command: Release the swarm. All of it. Even the broken ones.
mott.loss: So someone finally kept it. Took them long enough.

vesh.pick: Everything is worth something. Especially your ship.
vesh.sector: New sector. New things to collect.
start: Patch the hulls. We will want them whole for later.
Fight carefully. I want their parts intact.
vesh.boss: Such a heavy flagship. I want its armour on my harness.
vesh.nemesis: {rival}. I have a place on my hull ready for your plating.
vesh.kill_flag: Their flagship is mine now. In pieces, but mine.
vesh.lost: We lost one of my ships. Collect the bits. I keep everything.
vesh.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is scratched. Patch it. Quickly.
vesh.command: Patch and weld. Every plate back on.
vesh.win: Collect the wrecks. All of them. Every bolt.
vesh.loss: My collection. Somebody else will wear it now.

matriarch.pick: We are many. We are hungry. We are mother.
matriarch.sector: New feeding grounds. The broods stir. Go, children. Go.
start: Release the broods. Feed.
Open the sacs. The children hunger.
matriarch.boss: A great shell full of meat. The children will crack it.
matriarch.nemesis: {rival}. You spoiled our young. Now you feed them.
matriarch.kill_flag: The great shell is open. Children, eat.
matriarch.lost: One of us goes quiet. The rest of us grow hungrier.
matriarch.flag_hurt: The mother is wounded. The children grow angry.
matriarch.command: Spawning surge. All broods, all at once.
matriarch.loss: The broods fall quiet. Mother waits. Mother is patient.

start: Hunt. Now.
Find the slow ones. Bite.
razormaw.lost: Pack loses one. Pack bites harder.
razormaw.command: Blood frenzy. All run. All bite.

mending.pick: Hush. Every wound is a doorway. We go in through it.
mending.sector: A new sector. So many broken things to mend into us.
start: Hush now. Grow, and bite.
Every cut they give us, we grow back thicker.
mending.boss: Their flagship is so hard, so brittle. We will soften it.
mending.nemesis: {rival}. Hush. You will be part of us soon.
mending.kill_flag: Their flagship opens like a wound. Mend it into us.
mending.lost: One of us did not mend in time. We will grow another.
mending.flag_hurt: We are torn. Hush. Mend. Mend.
mending.win: All mended. All whole. All hungry.
mending.loss: Too many wounds. Even we cannot mend this.

voice.pick: Listen. Under the static. That wet sound is us, and it burns.
voice.sector: A new sector. Let the deep throats open on it.
start: Open wide. Let the acid fall.
Open every throat. Let them taste us.
voice.boss: Their flagship is hot metal. We will make it soft.
voice.nemesis: {rival}. We have your scent. We say your name while we eat.
voice.kill_flag: Their flagship dissolves. We drink it.
voice.lost: A throat closes. The others open wider.
voice.flag_hurt: The Voice is wounded. It spits harder.
voice.command: Spitting volley. Every throat at once.
voice.win: We swallow. We are full. For now.
voice.loss: The throats close. They will open somewhere else.

aelith.pick: Open the apertures. The dark is wide and we are quick.
aelith.sector: A new sky. My starlings will learn it by its light.
start: Starlings, fly. Light and quick.
Wings out. Make them look everywhere at once.
aelith.boss: A heavy flagship. Heavy things cannot follow starlings.
aelith.nemesis: {rival}. The mirror-buoys flashed your name. My wings remember it.
aelith.kill_flag: Their flagship falls. I am sorry for its crew. Starlings, home.
aelith.lost: A ship is gone. Three centuries of a life, gone in a breath.
aelith.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is wounded. Starlings, cover her.
aelith.command: Starling flight. Every wing, every carrier.
aelith.win: Bring the wings home. The sky is quiet.
aelith.loss: The starlings scatter. The sky is dark again. Forgive me.

vaelen.pick: One beam, held long enough, cuts anything. We hold it.
vaelen.sector: A new sector. Bring the lenses to focus.
start: Lances, find your focus.
Hold the beam. Let the glass do the work.
vaelen.boss: Their flagship is thick armour. Thick armour is only slow glass.
vaelen.nemesis: {rival}. You broke our glass once. Now hold still for the light.
vaelen.kill_flag: Their flagship is cut through. I am sorry it had to be.
vaelen.lost: A lens is broken. We cannot grind another like it.
vaelen.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is struck. Keep the focus.
vaelen.command: Burning glass. Every lance, one point.
vaelen.win: The beam held. Let the lenses cool.
vaelen.loss: The focus is lost. Who will grind the next lens?

thorne.pick: You will not see us. That is the point.
thorne.sector: A new sector. We come in on the glare, like a reflection.
start: Mirrors angled. Be where they are not looking.
Drift. Wait. Then strike out of the glare.
thorne.boss: A great flagship, staring at our reflection. We are behind it.
thorne.nemesis: {rival}. They hunt reflections. We are the reflections.
thorne.lost: One mirror shattered. The rest still turn.
thorne.flag_hurt: The {flagship} has been seen. Hide her in the glare.
thorne.command: Scatter the light. Every ship, slip away.
thorne.loss: The mirrors are broken. Even a reflection can be caught.

mirelle.pick: The prism holds. The light bends. The fleet endures.
mirelle.sector: A new sector. Raise the wards. We are too few to lose any.
start: Wards up. Bend their fire away.
Prisms aligned. Let their fire scatter.
mirelle.boss: Their flagship burns bright. The prism will bend it.
mirelle.nemesis: {rival}. You will not touch my ships.
mirelle.kill_flag: Their flagship is broken. The light is ours.
mirelle.lost: A ship is lost. The ward was not enough. It must be more.
mirelle.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is hurt. Every ward to the flagship.
mirelle.command: Prism ward. Every shield, whole again.
mirelle.win: The wards held. Every light came home.
mirelle.loss: The prism shatters. I am sorry. I am so sorry.

nekhet.pick: This is my ninth body. I remember all of them, and the sun before them.
nekhet.sector: Another sector closer to home. The dark here is younger than ours.
start: Advance. If you fall, the Archive keeps you.
Begin. We have done this for a thousand years.
nekhet.boss: A flagship. It burns warm. I remember warm.
nekhet.nemesis: {rival}. You have stood between us and noon. Step aside.
nekhet.kill_flag: Their flagship is gone. Theirs does not come back.
nekhet.lost: A frame falls. The mind is backed up. Mark the place.
nekhet.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is damaged. It is a temporary condition.
nekhet.command: Release the repair swarms. Every hull, rebuilt.
nekhet.win: We remember noon. We are a little closer to it.
nekhet.loss: We go dark here. Not all of us. Not for long.

sekhmar.pick: I was a lens-grinder once, with hands. Now I aim the corona.
sekhmar.sector: A new sector. Its star is small. It will do.
start: Corona arcs charged. Begin.
Strike at noon. Every arc.
sekhmar.boss: A great hull. I have broken greater, three bodies ago.
sekhmar.nemesis: {rival}. Your light ends today. Ours does not.
sekhmar.lost: One frame lost. The rest strike on.
sekhmar.win: The field is dark. As it should be.

anuket.pick: I have been copied many times. Every copy learned to be quiet.
anuket.sector: A new sector. Move in its shadow.
start: Silent running. Find their backs.
Let them hear nothing until the end.
anuket.boss: A loud flagship. It will not hear us coming.
anuket.lost: One shadow lost. The rest stay quiet.
anuket.command: Out of the shadow. All frames, now.
anuket.loss: The silence breaks. It will return.

khepra.pick: I have been restored twice. I was not finished either time.
khepra.sector: A new sector. We will outlast it, as we outlast everything.
start: Stand. Let them strike the plates.
Patience. They tire. We do not.
khepra.boss: A great flagship. We have outlasted greater.
khepra.nemesis: {rival}. I have waited longer than your kind has existed. I can wait out you.
khepra.kill_flag: Their flagship is dust. The plates remain.
khepra.lost: One frame falls. The wall remains.
khepra.flag_hurt: The {flagship} is cracked. It has cracked before.
khepra.command: Sunshade wall. Every hull behind the plates.
khepra.win: We remain. As we always do.
khepra.loss: Even we wear down. Slowly. Restore me a third time.

factions._about: Lines spoken by an enemy sector flagship (boss_hail at battle start, boss_down when it dies), in its faction's voice.

voidsworn.boss_hail: Who carries the dawn? We do. Stand aside, or be chalked with the dead.
voidsworn.boss_down: Chalk... my name... under the line...

hegemony.boss_hail: You are in violation of Hegemony space. The Registry projects your removal. Surrender is not an offered option.
hegemony.boss_down: Flagship lost. Transmit the... final log...

corsair.boss_hail: We heard your engines three jumps out. Your wake stinks of fear.

chorus.boss_hail: We hear you. We taste you. We are coming.

ithar.boss_hail: Turn back. We have lost enough light already. Do not make us take yours.
ithar.boss_down: Another light goes out. There were so few left.

deathless.boss_hail: You stand between us and noon. We remember noon. You will not.
